children: Ofgem has opened a consultation on a draft determination provisionally proposing to disallow up to £24M of Smart DCC costs for 2025/2026, versus a draft disallowance of £31M for 2024/2025. A final determination is expected in Q1 2027.
Up to £24M in costs provisionally disallowed
The potential cost disallowance is lower than the prior year's £31M draft, but remains subject to consultation and a final determination.
Final price determination expected in Q1 2027
The outcome could change the proposed disallowance; Smart DCC will seek a reduction during consultation.
Smart DCC is not consolidated in Capita's accounts
The release states the subsidiary is wholly owned but not consolidated, limiting direct read-through to reported group financials.

This is a recurring regulatory process for the Smart DCC contract, rather than a new operating initiative. The final Ofgem price determination in Q1 2027 will establish whether the proposed disallowance changes.
Based on the original press release from Capita plc distributed by MFN by Modular Finance.
